name: OpenNMS Horizon
description: Enterprise-grade Java network monitoring platform providing discovery, polling, and performance data collection.

envVars.description: Password for the OpenNMS PostgreSQL database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      POSTGRES_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      POSTGRES_DB: opennms
      POSTGRES_USER: opennms
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/opt/opennms/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: opennms
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: opennms
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
